prompt:
Allocate these household transfers to three robots. Return JSON only.
Instruction: Move CreditCard to Cabinet; KeyChain to CoffeeTable; Laptop to Cabinet; Pillow to CoffeeTable; RemoteControl to Cabinet; Statue to CoffeeTable, and leave the destination containers closed.
Jobs: [{"id":"j0","object":"CreditCard","destination":"Cabinet"},{"id":"j1","object":"KeyChain","destination":"CoffeeTable"},{"id":"j2","object":"Laptop","destination":"Cabinet"},{"id":"j3","object":"Pillow","destination":"CoffeeTable"},{"id":"j4","object":"RemoteControl","destination":"Cabinet"},{"id":"j5","object":"Statue","destination":"CoffeeTable"}]
Robots 0,1,2 can each carry one object. Robots 0 and 2 can open/close containers. Each job is indivisible: one robot picks and places. A compiler adds required container actions. Provide 12 distinct allocations and job priority orders. Return {"plans":[...]} with each plan containing "robots" (one robot ID for every job, indexed by job ID), "order" (every job ID exactly once), "opener" (0 or 2), "closer" (0 or 2). Vary both assignments and order. No explanation.
